text: **dsh-qwen-studio**（DSH 网页插件）：在 DSH 中使用 Qwen Image 2.1 创建和编辑图片。它在侧边栏提供图像工作台，并注册生成、导入、任务状态、预设和图库工具。用户可进行文生图、参考图变化或原生指令编辑，管理 LoRA、ControlNet、蒙版、批量任务和结果。适合需要在 DSH 对话或工作台中制作图像的用户。本机模式需自行配置 MFLUX 与模型权重；远程模式需配置自托管服务。

**dsh-qwen-studio** (DSH web plugin): Generate Qwen Image pictures in DSH with prompts or reference edits. Sidebar and agent tools add LoRAs, ControlNet, masks, batches, presets and gallery search. Configure local MFLUX/model weights or a remote service.

dsh-qwen-studio 的功能「提示词生图」：在图像工作台提交提示词和尺寸、步数等参数，任务完成后图片作为对话附件返回。
dsh-qwen-studio 的功能「参考图编辑」：导入图片后可提交变化幅度式变体，或在支持的后端用文字指令编辑参考图。
dsh-qwen-studio 的功能「图像资源管理」：导入图片并列出可用参考图、LoRA 等资源，供生成参数选择。
dsh-qwen-studio 的功能「参数预设」：保存、加载、改名、设默认或导入导出完整参数组合，工作台与 Agent 共用预设库。
dsh-qwen-studio 的功能「批量生成」：一次提交 1–10 个独立任务，按并行上限分波并返回任务 ID。
dsh-qwen-studio 的功能「任务图库」：按提示词、种子、状态或收藏等条件浏览任务，并可查看来源关系或导出完成结果。
dsh-qwen-studio 的功能「连接切换」：读取或切换本机与远程执行模式，并调整共享空闲时间设置。
dsh-qwen-studio 使用前须知：本机推理依赖预先配置的 MFLUX 和 Qwen Image 2.1 模型权重；插件不会随包分发权重。
dsh-qwen-studio 使用前须知：远程模式需设置服务地址；配套 Qwen 网关需要网关密钥，具体连接由用户自行配置。

dsh-qwen-studio README · 先看这台机器跑不跑得动：Qwen Image 2.1 有量化版本，**门槛比想象中低**。按显存/内存挑档位，别一上来就下 bf16 全家桶：

| 环境 | 最低（量化） | 舒适 | 能做多少 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Apple Silicon Mac | MFLUX + 对应 MLX 权重 | 本次实机为 128 GB Apple Silicon | 16/24/32 GB 设备未做本版实测，不承诺低内存原生编辑；按模型实际峰值预留系统内存 |
| Windows + NVIDIA | 本包仅验证 24 GB RTX 4090 D 的指定 int8 safetensors | 24 GB | 不支持直接替换 GGUF；10–12 GB 尚未真机验证 |
| bf16 全量 | 另行核算权重、编码器和推理峰值 | 本版未验收 | 不能仅凭权重精度承诺最高画质或固定内存门槛 |
| Intel Mac / 无独显 | — | — | 只装插件看界面，推理走局域网里带 GPU 的机器 |

text:
dsh-qwen-studio README · 三步开始：**1. 安装插件。** 从 [Releases](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio/releases/latest) 下载 `.tgz`，运行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/dsh-qwen-studio-<version>.tgz
```

macOS 未安装全局 `dsh` 时，可使用桌面版内置 CLI：

```sh
sh "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/dsh-qwen-studio-<version>.tgz
```

**2. 选择推理位置。** 正常退出并重新打开 DSH，在插件设置中配置「图像」：

dsh-qwen-studio README · 三步开始：| 本机 Apple Silicon Mac | 自己的 NVIDIA GPU（Windows / Linux） |
| --- | --- |
| Python 3.12 + MFLUX 0.22.0 | 配套 CUDA / ComfyUI Qwen 网关 |
| 准备完整 Qwen Image 2.1 权重 | 准备服务器模型与访问地址 |
| 选择 Python 环境、模型和图库目录 | 填写 `/v1` 地址、模型名、配套网关必需的密钥及可选 SSH 别名 |
| [本机安装步骤 →](docs/SETUP.md) | [远程部署步骤 →](docs/REMOTE.md) |
| Python 3.12 + MFLUX 0.22.0 | 网关默认 `127.0.0.1:19488`，模型 `qwen-image-2.1-int8` |

dsh-qwen-studio README · 三步开始：Windows 没有 MLX：本机只装插件看界面，真正的推理要么走局域网里的 NVIDIA 机器，要么用同一台机器的 GPU 跑网关。Windows 上 `dsh` 是 `.cmd`，必须用 `dsh.cmd` 或 `cmd /c dsh.cmd`，直接 `dsh` 会 EINVAL。

模型权重独立准备，不随插件分发，也不会在首次打开时自动下载几十 GB 文件。原生编辑需要含视觉编码器与 `processor` 的完整模型；纯文本导出不通用。已有用户原位升级，沿用当前数据目录与预设。

**3. 开始创作。** 左侧「图像 → 创作」输入描述；或在会话中说：

> 画一张清晨山间小屋的横版插画。
>
> 上网找一张陶瓷杯参考图，用图像插件改成水彩。
>
> 用我现有的 LoRA 和控制图保存一套预设，先不要生成。
>
> 把刚才那张图再显示一次，不要重新生成。

dsh-qwen-studio README · 两种参考模式，明确选择：| 模式 | 适合什么 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **参考变体** | 保留原图、做轻微变化 | `source_image_id` + `change_strength`；旧预设默认行为 |
| **原生参考编辑** | 按指令换画风、改颜色、编辑主体 | `source_image_id` + `reference_mode="edit"`；完整采样 |

创作页选择参考图后，在高级设置中选「参考图用法」。Agent 先查询当前后端 `reference_edit.supported`，再选择模式。组件缺失会明确提示，不会静默删参数或切换到另一台机器。

原生编辑目前使用 `linear` 和 32 倍数尺寸，不与控制图、蒙版混用；同一 LoRA 通道可用，具体适配器的编辑效果需实测。本机启用前缀 KV 复用，**不启用跳步缓存、Turbo 或隐式重试**。前缀缓存会记录在结果中；固定种子也不保证跨后端像素一致。

text:
dsh-qwen-studio README · Agent 也能配置，不只是按下生成：| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `qwen_image_import` | 图片直链、本机文件、真实会话附件 → 资源 ID；不启动推理 |
| `qwen_image_resources` | 查询 LoRA、图片输入与当前原生编辑能力 |
| `qwen_image_presets` | 保存、加载、重命名、默认、导入导出整套参数 |
| `qwen_generate_image` | 提交同一持久队列，返回图片附件和任务 ID |
| `qwen_image_status` | 查进度、取回原结果，不重新生成 |
| `qwen_image_jobs` | 一次批量查 200 个任务；查看活动队列与状态计数 |
| `qwen_image_cancel` | 按 ID 批量取消正在排队/生成的任务，不删图 |
| `qwen_image_gallery` | 只读检索图库：提示词、种子、状态、收藏、血缘字段 |
| `qwen_image_batch` | 一次提交 1–10 个任务，按 4 个准入位自动分波，返回真实 ID |
| `qwen_image_import_many` | 批量导入 1–20 个本机文件；同内容同用途复用 ID |
| `qwen_image_export` | 把完成任务复制成 `<id>/image.png + job.json + manifest`，不改图库 |
| `qwen_image_score` | 本地客观指标：边缘/颗粒/饱和度/肤色占比/高光剪切；只报告，不判 pass/fail |
| `qwen_image_reroll` | 按 QA 标记（默认 grain/texture）重投，种子 +1，保留原图 |
| `qwen_image_connection` | 实时切本机/远程、修改统一空闲时间 |

text:
dsh-qwen-studio README · Agent 也能配置，不只是按下生成：工具之间的分工、重叠边界与常见组合见 [docs/TOOLS.md](docs/TOOLS.md)。

只配置不生图，只写提示词不生图；已提交任务超时先查状态，不自动重提或绕去执行独立脚本。找图使用当前会话已有搜索/浏览器工具，插件不自带搜索引擎。

导入支持 PNG/JPEG/WebP；公开直链需能直接取得图片，HTML 页面需先提取图片 URL。逐跳校验公网地址、限制大小和耗时；Fake-IP 兼容仅限本插件请求，不修改系统代理或 DNS。远程资源按 SHA256 同步，预设里的本机文件名不会被误当成服务器路径。

dsh-qwen-studio README · 已验证，也有边界：[实测记录](docs/VERIFICATION.md) 区分自动检查、插件执行体联调和原生 DSH 验收，保留具体版本与限制。2.19.0 的 Windows 修复及逐项验收见实测记录；历史版本的 UI 与 GPU 验收不自动代表本版已通过。2.13–2.17 新增批量提交/导入、只读检索、导出、客观评分、按标记重投与 Qwen 2.1 原生多图编辑；先前 2.11.0 还完成本机 MLX 蓝杯转水彩实测。当前测试覆盖 Apple Silicon / MFLUX 与 Windows / RTX 4090 D；Linux 远程尚未完成真实 GPU 验收，CI 不运行模型推理。

自然语言触发已在 DSH / DeepSeek-V41-Flash 验证；其他模型取决于工具能力、上下文与 DSH 权限。原生编辑不保证每条指令成功，通路可用也不等于任意第三方 LoRA 都有好效果。

图库与预设保存在自己选择的数据目录，升级不迁移或清空原件。导出预设只包含参数和资源指纹，不含模型、图像文件、连接密钥或设备绝对路径；缺失资源加载时明确提示。[安装与数据说明 →](docs/SETUP.md)

dsh-qwen-studio README · Installation and agent onboarding：**Bring your own model and server.** No personal deployment addresses, private IPs, model paths or API keys are included. Add the [native DSH market index](https://kingcharleslzy-ai.github.io/dsh-qwen-studio/index.json) or use the [shared market](https://kingcharleslzy-ai.github.io/dsh-purge/index.json). Market snapshots are precompiled and pinned to immutable commits.

dsh-qwen-studio README · Installation and agent onboarding：From 2.12.0, automatic checks default to every 6 hours; automatic installation defaults off. Installation defers while tasks are active, verifies SHA256 and creates a rollback package. DSH never restarts automatically. Models, gallery contents, presets and remote services are outside the plugin update payload.

dsh-qwen-studio README · Direct creation and agent tools, in one workspace：- **Create without a chat model.** Open **图像** in DSH's left sidebar. Write a prompt, pick a reference, generate and iterate in place.
- **Let an agent do it.** The bundled skill guides a tool-capable model through search → image import → generation. Chat and the creation page share real progress and completed images.
- **Native instruction editing.** Both supported local MFLUX and the bundled remote gateway condition on image and text. Existing strength-based variations remain available with unchanged preset semantics.
- **Advanced controls.** Select LoRAs, ControlNet inputs and masks with native file pickers or reusable resource lists. Configure negative prompts, CFG and supported schedulers.
- **Complete presets.** Save, reload, rename, set a default, import or export JSON. The panel and agent use the same resource and preset stores.
- **Persistent jobs.** Switching pages does not cancel generation. Retrieve an existing result without generating again.
- **On-demand resources.** Local inference starts when needed. Plugin-owned remote SSH starts on generation and disconnects after confirmed model unloading

text:
dsh-qwen-studio README · Quick start：1. Download the compiled `.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio/releases/latest).
2. Install, then quit and reopen DSH:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/dsh-qwen-studio-2.12.0.tgz
```

On macOS without a global CLI:

```sh
sh "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \
  plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/dsh-qwen-studio-2.12.0.tgz
```

dsh-qwen-studio README · Quick start：3. Configure **图像** in plugin settings. Choose local Apple Silicon or your own remote gateway, then open the creation page or ask the agent to generate.

**Local:** Apple Silicon, Python 3.12, MFLUX 0.22.0 and separately prepared Qwen Image 2.1 weights. Native editing needs a complete checkpoint with the vision encoder and processor; text-only exports are insufficient. Memory requirements depend on weights, resolution and extra components. [Setup guide](docs/SETUP.md).

dsh-qwen-studio README · Quick start：**Remote:** deploy the bundled Qwen gateway with your ComfyUI installation and model files. Configure its `/v1` address, model, required gateway key (at least 16 characters) and optional SSH alias. Ordinary OpenAI-compatible Images APIs support basic text-to-image only; do not enter a raw ComfyUI address as an Images endpoint. Windows / 24 GB NVIDIA GPU is GPU-tested; Linux lifecycle code is not yet GPU-qualified. [Remote guide](docs/REMOTE.md).
dsh-qwen-studio README · Quick start：Weights are not distributed or automatically downloaded. In-place upgrades preserve your configured data directory, existing presets and gallery originals.

dsh-qwen-studio README · Choose the reference mode：| Mode | Intended use | Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Variation | Small changes while retaining the source | `source_image_id` + `change_strength` |
| Native edit | Instruction edits, style transfer, recoloring | `source_image_id` + `reference_mode="edit"` |

dsh-qwen-studio README · Choose the reference mode：Select **参考图用法 → 按指令编辑 · Qwen 原生** after choosing a reference. Agents check `qwen_image_resources.reference_edit.supported` on the current backend first. Missing APIs or vision weights are reported before model startup; there is no silent backend fallback.

dsh-qwen-studio README · Choose the reference mode：Native editing currently requires `linear`, dimensions divisible by 32, and one reference. It cannot be combined with masks or ControlNet in this plugin. The LoRA channel is shared, but adapter edit quality depends on its training. Local editing uses prefix KV reuse, full denoising, no step skipping, no Turbo, no automatic prompt rewrite and no hidden retries. Fixed seeds do not imply identical pixels across backends.

dsh-qwen-studio README · Tools an agent can discover：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `qwen_image_import` | Public image URL, host-local path or real conversation attachment → managed image ID |
| `qwen_image_resources` | List actual image inputs / LoRAs and current native-edit availability |
| `qwen_image_presets` | Configure, save, load and share complete parameter sets |
| `qwen_generate_image` | Submit to the durable queue; return an image attachment and task ID |
| `qwen_image_status` | Check real progress or recover the same completed result |
| `qwen_image_connection` | Switch local/remote live and update the shared idle timeout |

dsh-qwen-studio README · Tools an agent can discover：The bundled [qwen-image skill](skills/qwen-image/SKILL.md) is registered automatically. Configuration-only and prompt-writing requests do not generate. Accepted tasks are queried before any retry; the agent should not bypass the plugin with standalone scripts. Search uses tools already available in the conversation, not a search engine bundled here.

dsh-qwen-studio README · Tools an agent can discover：Imported PNG/JPEG/WebP inputs stay separate from generated gallery works. URLs are checked on each redirect and pinned to validated public addresses. Remote assets transfer by content hash, not guessed server filenames. Fake-IP compatibility is scoped to import requests and does not alter system proxy or DNS settings.

dsh-qwen-studio README · Verification, contribution and licenses：Version 2.11.0 passed 65 tool/UI tests and 31 backend tests. Native DSH selected local reference editing and completed all 40 steps with synchronized chat/creation results; all 355 pre-existing configuration, preset and gallery files retained their hashes. See [verification](docs/VERIFICATION.md) for automated checks, real GPU tests and native DSH acceptance. CI does not run GPU inference. Tool selection has been tested with DSH / DeepSeek-V41-Flash; other models depend on their tool support, context and DSH permissions.

dsh-qwen-studio README · Verification, contribution and licenses：```sh
git clone https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio.git
cd dsh-qwen-studio
python -m pip install "Pillow>=11,<13" "numpy>=1.26,<3" "aiohttp>=3.10,<4"
npm ci --ignore-scripts

Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`; worker tests require Python 3.12, Pillow 11–12, numpy 1.26–2.x and aiohttp 3.x. [Report an issue](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio/issues) with versions, reproduction steps and errors after removing private data.

dsh-qwen-studio README · Verification, contribution and licenses：Originated from [shanliuling/dsh-image-gen](https://github.com/shanliuling/dsh-image-gen)'s DSH integration and now maintained independently. Code: [Apache-2.0](LICENSE), original attribution in [NOTICE](NOTICE). Documentation images have [separate credits/licenses](docs/media/CREDITS.md). Model weights and inference dependencies retain their own licenses. Not an official Qwen, MFLUX or DeepSeek plugin.

dsh-qwen-studio README · Verification, contribution and licenses：2.12.0 acceptance: 77 TypeScript/UI tests and 31 worker tests, native DSH update controls, a real 40-step chat generation synchronized to the creation panel, page switching, favorite/private-gallery routing and the shared market card. Native package installation and rollback were exercised in isolated profiles. See [verification](docs/VERIFICATION.md) for scope and limits.

dsh-qwen-studio README · Verification, contribution and licenses：Remote clients also need Python 3.10+, Pillow and numpy for image imports/scoring. Run `python scripts/setup-image-python.py` (`python3` on macOS) inside the installed package and enter the printed executable in settings. Windows uses `venv\Scripts\python.exe`. The bundled gateway requires a private API key of at least 16 characters and the documented int8 safetensors; GGUF and 10–12 GB GPUs are not validated configurations.
